PRE_FLIGHT.description: Assemble merged_readme_review messages; check request ceiling before spending the normal call.

transitions.when: assembled request <= 200 KB
assembled request > 200 KB

NORMAL_CALL.description: The one preserved normal merged-review call.
NORMAL_CALL.function: client.analyze(messages) inside execute_merged_readme_review, now wrapped in try/except

transitions.when: client.analyze returns without raising
LLMTruncatedResponseError raised (finish_reason == "length")
transitions.source: new: llm/verifier_client.py::_parse_response, checked before the JSON-decode branch

transitions.when: LLMError raised, not a subtype below (malformed JSON args, non-length finish_reason)
LLMInfrastructureError raised (HTTP 401/403/5xx or exhausted transport retry)
transitions.source: existing: llm/verifier_client.py:_request, transport_max_attempts=1 so no gateway-level retry occurs first

PARSE_TOP_LEVEL.description: Validate the merged response has exactly the {quality, factual} keys, both dict-shaped.
PARSE_TOP_LEVEL.function: execute_merged_readme_review, existing check at merged_readme_review.py:75-80, now raising a typed MergedReviewSchemaError instead of bare LLMError

transitions.when: parsed has exactly {quality, factual}, both dicts
keys missing/extra, or either facet is not a dict
transitions.source: existing check, new exception type MergedReviewSchemaError(LLMError)

PARSE_FACTUAL_FACET.description: Project the factual payload through run_grounded_role with max_attempts_override=1 (existing).

transitions.when: grounding succeeds
GroundedRoleFailure raised
transitions.source: existing GroundedRoleFailure, currently UNCAUGHT here -- this is the primary defect this design fixes

PARSE_BLIND_FACET.description: Project the quality payload through run_grounded_role with max_attempts_override=1 (existing).

transitions.when: grounding succeeds
GroundedRoleFailure raised
transitions.source: existing, already caught today via blind_fallback_client -- this design keeps that behavior and only unifies it under the same receipt

RECOVERY_DISPATCH.description: New: classify which facet(s) are unresolved and invoke only the matching separated client(s), each bounded to max_attempts_override=2.
RECOVERY_DISPATCH.precondition: blind_fallback_client and/or factual_fallback_client is not None (both None => fall through to FAIL_CLOSED, preserving today's exact behavior for callers that supply neither)

transitions.when: "blind" in facets_unresolved and blind_fallback_client is not None
"factual" in facets_unresolved and factual_fallback_client is not None
an unresolved facet has no matching fallback client supplied

RECOVER_BLIND.description: Isolated blind-quality call using build_blind_quality_review_messages, existing mechanism, now reachable from every failure_kind, not just blind_grounding_failure.
RECOVER_BLIND.calls_spent: 1 or 2 (initial + at most 1 compact grounding retry, internal to run_grounded_role)

transitions.when: succeeds and factual facet already resolved from NORMAL_CALL
succeeds and factual facet also unresolved (join point)
GroundedRoleFailure raised even after the bounded compact retry

RECOVER_FACTUAL.description: Isolated factual-plan call using build_factual_plan_review_messages -- new: symmetric to RECOVER_BLIND, using a new factual_fallback_client parameter.
RECOVER_FACTUAL.calls_spent: 1 or 2 (initial + at most 1 compact grounding retry, internal to run_grounded_role)

transitions.when: succeeds and blind facet already resolved from NORMAL_CALL
succeeds and blind facet was also recovered in RECOVER_BLIND
GroundedRoleFailure raised even after the bounded compact retry

AWAIT_FACTUAL_RECOVERY.description: Join point when both facets are unresolved: RECOVER_BLIND and RECOVER_FACTUAL both run (order does not affect the call-count ceiling; sequential in the reference implementation).

transitions.when: always

RESOLVED.description: Normal-path success. No recovery attempted. QwenReviewRecoveryReceiptV1 is None.

RESOLVED_PARTIAL.description: One or both facets resolved via recovery. QwenReviewRecoveryReceiptV1 is populated with the failure_kind, which facet(s) recovered, attempt counts, token usage, and latency.

FAIL_CLOSED.description: No fallback client supplied for an unresolved facet -- identical to today's behavior when blind_fallback_client is None (test_merged_false_missing_premise_fails_closed_without_repeating_call). Preserved unchanged as the zero-fallback-client default.
FAIL_CLOSED.raises: the original classified exception (LLMTruncatedResponseError | LLMError | LLMInfrastructureError | MergedReviewSchemaError | GroundedRoleFailure)

SYSTEM_FAILURE.description: Recovery was attempted (fallback client(s) supplied) but a facet still failed grounding after its bounded compact retry. Surfaces as SYSTEM_FAILURE verdict via the existing BlindQualityReviewResultV1/FactualPlanReviewResultV1 SYSTEM_FAILURE shape, never as a synthetic REJECT_REPAIRABLE -- this is the requirement-11 non-interference invariant: a recovery exhaustion must not consume MAX_REPAIR_ATTEMPTS budget by masquerading as a repairable rejection.

invariants: Every path from PRE_FLIGHT to a terminal state spends at most 5 physical provider calls.
RESOLVED is the only terminal state reachable in exactly 1 call.
No transition ever re-sends the full merged request; RECOVER_BLIND/RECOVER_FACTUAL always use the smaller separated prompts.

candidate_text, product_facts, and visitor_contract passed into RECOVER_BLIND/RECOVER_FACTUAL are byte-identical to those used in NORMAL_CALL -- verified by a dedicated invariant test, not just by convention.
